title: System limits — etcd v3.7
version: etcd v3.7 official online documentation; accessed 2026-11-26.
locator: Request size limit section: default maximum client request size is 1.5 MiB and is configurable with --max-request-bytes; larger requests may increase latency.
notes: Official project documentation. The default request limit is a reference only; actual server configuration must be verified for each deployment.
